text.p: Salomon Brothers said Thursday that analyst Brett Barakett cut his 1997 and 1998 per share earnings estimates on Converse Inc after the footwear manufacturer reported second quarter earnings late Wednesday.
- 1997 per share earnings esimates cut to $0.30 from $0.70.
- 1998 per share earnings estimates cut to $1.20 from $1.30.
- Converse expects second half earnings below expectations due to competitive pressures in Japan and from Nike Inc and lower operating margins, Barakett said.
- However, company's fundamental strength is good and turnaround continues, he said.
- Converse reported second quarter earnings per share of zero cents versus a loss of $0.22 last year.
